ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the empty sickroom

plain.li: Every bed in the sickroom was made up and empty in my dream, and the last patient was walking out into the sun.
[goal:Midwife] I caught a baby in my dream, and it looked up at me as if it already knew who I was.
[goal:Surgeon] The operation went right in my dream, every cut where it should be, and the patient sat up and asked for soup.
[goal:TenLives] Everyone I've pulled through was standing in a line at the gate in my dream, and the line went out of sight.

warm.li: In my dream the colony was well, every last one of us, and I sat with my hands in my lap and didn't mind at all.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I set a leg so well the patient danced out of the room!

gloomy.li: The beds were empty in my dream. I couldn't tell if they'd all got well or I'd been too late.

cold.li: A dream of a treatment that went well. I'll take it as encouragement. I still mean to {GOAL}.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the fight going right

plain.li: In my dream every shot went where I meant it to, and the fight was over before the dust settled.
[goal:Mechbane] A mechanoid came over the wall in my dream, and I found the seam in its armor on the first try.
[goal:Hunter] Tracked a great stag through the whole dream, and when I finally had the shot, it turned and looked at me.
[goal:Blademaster] I fought someone faster than me in my dream and matched them blow for blow, until they stepped back and bowed.
[goal:Avenge] I faced the ones who did it in my dream, and they were smaller than I remembered.

warm.li: Dreamt we won without anyone of ours getting hurt. That's the only kind of win I want.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I hit the mark from so far away they had to send a runner to check!

gloomy.li: I won the fight in my dream. It didn't feel the way I thought it would.

cold.li: Every move correct, in my dream. I still mean to {GOAL}.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the colony finished

plain.li: The colony in my dream was finished, every roof on and every wall straight, and there were lights in windows I hadn't built yet.
[goal:Mountain] We'd carved halls deep into the mountain in my dream, cool and quiet, with a hearth at the end of each one.
[goal:Room] I had a room of my own in the dream, with a real bed and a rug, and a window that looked out on the fields.
[goal:Township|goal:Grow] The colony had grown into a town in my dream, with a market and a well in the square, and I knew everyone's name.
[goal:ChildBuilder] I built a den in my dream with a door and a roof and a secret way out the back.
[goal:Spotless] Every floor in the colony was swept in my dream, and it stayed swept.

warm.li: Dreamt of the colony years from now, warm and full, and everyone in it had a room of their own.

blunt.li: Dreamt it was all built. Back to work.

cheerful.li: In my dream we built a tower so tall the birds had to go round it!

gloomy.li: The colony was finished in my dream, and I was too old to enjoy it.

cold.li: A dream of the finished settlement. The plan was sound. We're behind on it.

plain.li: The storeroom was so full in my dream that the door wouldn't shut, and sacks of grain spilled out into the snow.
[goal:Cook] I cooked a supper in my dream that made the whole table go quiet, and then ask for more.
[goal:ChildGarden] My little seed grew into a tree in the dream, and it had apples on it, and I picked one.
[goal:Herd] The herd in my dream filled the whole valley, and I could tell every one of them apart.

warm.li: Dreamt there was enough food for every hungry mouth on the rim, and some left over.

blunt.li: Full stores. Good dream. Back to the fields.

cheerful.li: The squashes in my dream were so big we hollowed one out and lived in it!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of a harvest so good it couldn't be real. It wasn't.

cold.li: Plenty, in my dream. Now to make it so.

plain.li: In my dream I understood something all the way through, the way you know a room you grew up in. Then it slipped away.
[goal:Teach|goal:Legacy] My student did it alone in my dream, without looking over at me once. I was so proud I couldn't speak.
[goal:ChildLetters] All the letters lined up in my dream and turned into words, and the words turned into a story.
[goal:Seer] I dreamt I was dreaming, and in the dream inside the dream I saw something coming. It'll come back to me.
[goal:Mastery|goal:ChildSkill|goal:TeenTrusted] I was the best at {SKILL} in the whole colony in my dream, and they all came to ask me how.

warm.li: Dreamt I explained it so well the children understood it the first time through. I'd like to manage that awake.

blunt.li: Worked it out in my sleep. Lost it on waking.

cheerful.li: I understood everything in my dream, the stars, the weather, even the cook's moods!

gloomy.li: The answer was written on the wall in my dream, and I couldn't read the writing.

cold.li: A dream of insight. The details didn't survive waking. The direction did.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the council listening

plain.li: I spoke at the council in my dream, and the room went quiet, and when I sat down they did what I'd said.
[story:WeightOfOffice] I was carrying my council seat on my back in my dream, the real wooden chair, up a hill that didn't end.
[goal:Name] In the dream I heard people in another town telling a story about me, and getting most of it right.
[goal:ChildProud|goal:TeenSeriously] The grown-ups asked me what I thought in my dream, and then they listened to the whole answer.
[goal:Quartermaster|goal:Steward|goal:Marshal] They handed me the keys in my dream, the whole ring of them, and every one fit a door.

warm.li: Dreamt each of us had our say at the meeting, and we all went home on speaking terms.

blunt.li: Council dream. They listened. Imagine that.

cheerful.li: I gave a speech in my dream and they carried me round the hall on their shoulders!

gloomy.li: I spoke at the council in my dream, and not one head turned.

cold.li: The council deferred to me in my dream. It felt natural.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a full table

plain.li: Every seat at the table was taken in my dream, and every one of them was someone glad to see me.
[story:FindingHome|goal:Belonging] In my dream someone had carved my name into the bench by the door, next to everyone else's.
[goal:BestFriend] My best friend and me had a den in my dream, and only the two of us knew the password.
[goal:ElderFamily] My family sat down together in my dream, all of us, and the old trouble stayed outside the door.
[goal:Hospitable] The gate was open in my dream and guests kept arriving, and there was always room for one more.

warm.li: Dreamt of friends, old and new, all laughing at the same thing. That's all I want.

blunt.li: Full table. Friends at it. Good dream.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I had so many friends we had to eat in shifts!

gloomy.li: A full table in my dream, and they all looked up when I came in. I could get used to that.

cold.li: A dream of company. More of it than I usually look for. I didn't mind.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of setting it down

plain.li: I'd been carrying a stone a long way in my dream, and I put it down by the road and walked on lighter.
[goal:Peace|goal:ElderPeace|story:GrudgeLaidDown] The one I've been at odds with held out a hand in my dream, and I took it without thinking.
[goal:HeartShame] In the dream I told someone the old thing, all of it, and they just nodded and passed the salt.
[goal:Endure|goal:LongHaul|goal:OneMoreYear] Seasons went past in my dream like pages turning, spring, summer, harvest, snow, and I was there for every one.
[goal:HeartPurpose] I woke inside my dream knowing exactly what I was for, and went straight out to do it.

warm.li: Dreamt the worst of it was behind me. I want to believe it.

blunt.li: Put something down in my dream. Felt lighter. Still do.

cheerful.li: In my dream I let it all go and floated up over the roofs like a dandelion seed!

gloomy.li: I put it down in my dream. I expect I'll pick it up again today.

cold.li: A dream of resolution. The thing I carry was absent. Instructive.

plain.li: I knelt at the shrine in my dream, and when I looked up the whole colony was kneeling beside me.
[goal:FaithAgain] Dreamt I found my faith again in a field, lying in the grass like something dropped, and it fit my hand.
[goal:FaithRole] In my dream I led the words at the gathering, and my voice didn't shake.

warm.li: Dreamt we all believed the same small good things, and it made us gentler with each other.

cheerful.li: Everyone sang together in my dream, even the ones who never sing!

gloomy.li: I prayed in my dream, and the silence afterward was the same as always.

cold.li: I dreamt of the faithful. I noted who was kneeling and who wasn't.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an old quarrel

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I were building the same wall from opposite ends in my dream, and we met in the middle without a word.
[story:OldWounds] In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} and I were back before it all went wrong, sitting on the step, sharing an apple.
[story:GrudgingRespect] {OTHER_nameDef} beat me at my own work in my dream, fair and square, and I shook {OTHER_possessive} hand.

warm.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I laughed about the whole thing, years from now, by a fire somewhere.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} in my dream. We talked. Didn't fight.

cheerful.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} and I won a three-legged race together. Neither of us could believe it!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} turned away in my dream, the way {OTHER_pronoun} always does.

cold.li: I dreamt of {OTHER_nameDef}. Our differences seemed smaller asleep.

plain.li: I finished the thing I'm making for {OTHER_nameDef} in my dream and handed it over, and {OTHER_pronoun} knew at once what it meant.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} was in trouble again, and this time I was the one who got there first.
Dreamt the debt was a stone in my pocket, and when I gave {OTHER_nameDef} the gift, the stone was gone.

warm.li: Dreamt I thanked {OTHER_nameDef} properly, with my hands and not just words.

blunt.li: Paid {OTHER_nameDef} back in my dream. Now to do it awake.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} loved the gift so much in my dream, {OTHER_pronoun} wore it to supper!

gloomy.li: In my dream the gift wasn't good enough, and I kept starting over.

cold.li: A dream about the debt to {OTHER_nameDef}. It was settled. I'd like it settled awake as well.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the master's bench

plain.li: My teacher's hands were on mine in my dream, guiding the work, and then they lifted away and I kept going.
[story:PassingItOn] I watched my student finish the piece in my dream, and it was better than mine, and I was glad.
[instory:PassingItOn] The old master handed me their tools in my dream, one by one, and said the name of each.
[story:Masterwork] The piece was finished in my dream, and my master looked at it a long time and said nothing at all.

warm.li: Dreamt my master and I worked side by side all day and didn't need to speak.

blunt.li: At the bench all night. Good work. Can't remember it.

cheerful.li: Made a masterpiece in my dream on the first try! The master nearly fell off the stool.

gloomy.li: My hands wouldn't do what I knew in the dream. I knew it all and couldn't show it.

cold.li: I saw the flaw in my method while I slept. I'll correct it.

plain.li: In my dream I said it out loud at supper, the whole thing, and everybody went on eating.
I wrote it on a strip of bark in the dream and set it on the river, and it came back to me at the bend.
Dreamt the secret was a bird in my coat, and when I opened the coat it flew up onto the roof and sat there singing.

warm.li: Dreamt I told my friend, and my friend said they'd known for ages and loved me anyway.

blunt.li: Told it in my dream. Nothing happened. Maybe nothing will.

cheerful.li: Said it in my dream, and the cook just nodded and passed the potatoes!

gloomy.li: I said it in my dream, and every face at the table changed.

cold.li: I rehearsed the telling in my sleep. The reception was mixed.

plain.li: The one I'm afraid of came to the gate in my dream, and I stood there and didn't step back.
[story:FearLaid] In my dream the fear was a dog tied in the yard, still barking, but the rope held, and after a while it lay down.
[story:FearFaced] I trained all night in my dream, and when it came, my hands knew what to do.

warm.li: Dreamt my friends stood with me when it came, shoulder to shoulder, and I wasn't afraid.

blunt.li: It came, in my dream. I stood. Good.

cheerful.li: In my dream I stared it down until it blinked and slunk off!

gloomy.li: I stood firm in my dream. I don't know if I will awake.

cold.li: I dreamt of the confrontation and held my ground. Useful practice.

plain.li: The same dream again. This time I noticed something new in it, a window I'd never seen.
It came back last night, every detail where I'd left it, and this time I got to the end of the corridor.
Same dream. I've started to know my way around it, like a house I lived in once.

warm.li: The dream came back, and this time someone was in it with me, holding a light.

cheerful.li: The dream came back, and I knew how it ended this time, so I skipped to the end!

cold.li: The recurring dream again. I've begun keeping notes on it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the last hill

plain.li: I was climbing in my dream and thought I'd never reach the top, and then I did, and the whole valley lay below me.
[story:SecondChances] In my dream the council read out my name and what I'd asked for, and said yes.
[story:WithinReach] Dreamt I'd already done it, the thing I've set my heart on, and I was looking back down the road I'd come.

warm.li: A friend walked beside me in my dream, and when I slowed down, so did they.

blunt.li: Nearly there, in my dream. Nearly there awake too.

cheerful.li: In my dream I ran the last stretch and didn't even get out of breath!

gloomy.li: The top of the hill kept moving in my dream. I kept climbing anyway.

cold.li: A dream of arrival. Premature, but encouraging.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a small hand

plain.li: A small hand closed around my finger in my dream and wouldn't let go, and I didn't want it to.
[story:NewParent] The baby slept the whole night through in my dream. I woke three times anyway to check.
[goal:Child] I dreamt of a child with my eyes, running across the yard toward me.

warm.li: Dreamt the little one was grown and kind and came back to visit with flowers.

blunt.li: Baby slept, in my dream. Only there.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the baby said my name, clear as anything, at two weeks old!

gloomy.li: The baby was crying in my dream, and I couldn't find where.

cold.li: I dreamt of the child. Instinct is a strange thing. I'm not used to it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the animal at my side

plain.li: An animal walked beside me all through the dream, never ahead and never behind, and I didn't have to call it.
[story:OldCompanion] My old companion was young again in my dream, running circles in the long grass, no gray at the muzzle at all.
[story:Stray] The stray came right up to the door in my dream and stepped inside, as if it had always lived here.
[story:Orphan] The little one I'm raising was full grown in my dream, and still came running when I whistled.
[story:AnimalRivalry] That animal was waiting in the doorway in my dream, the way it does, and this time it let me pass.

warm.li: Dreamt the animal and I sat in the sun together, doing nothing, and it was the best afternoon.

cheerful.li: In my dream the animal brought me a present, and it wasn't even a dead mouse!

gloomy.li: The animal walked away in my dream and didn't look back.

cold.li: The animal trusted me in my dream. I may have earned that.
